name: University of Tokyo
overview: Japan's oldest and most selective national university, with English-taught undergraduate programmes through PEAK and a wide English-medium graduate catalogue across science, engineering and the humanities.

name: Kyoto University
overview: A national research university known for fundamental science and a long record of Nobel laureates, offering English-taught graduate programmes and the Kyoto iUP undergraduate route.

name: Osaka University
overview: A large national university strong in engineering, medicine and the life sciences, with dedicated English-medium graduate programmes for international students.

name: Tohoku University
overview: A national university in Sendai with an established Future Global Leadership undergraduate programme taught entirely in English in engineering and the sciences.

name: Nagoya University
overview: A national research university offering the G30 International Programs, a set of degrees taught wholly in English at both undergraduate and graduate level.

name: Kyushu University
overview: A national university in Fukuoka with English-taught undergraduate and graduate programmes in engineering, bioresource sciences and design.

name: Hokkaido University
overview: One of Japan's original imperial universities, with the English-taught Integrated Science Program and strengths in agriculture, veterinary science and environmental research.

name: University of Tsukuba
overview: A national university at the centre of Japan's largest science city, offering English-taught degrees in life sciences, engineering and international social studies.

name: Waseda University
overview: A large private university in Tokyo with one of Japan's biggest international student populations and extensive English-taught degrees in politics, economics, science and engineering.

name: Keio University
overview: Japan's oldest private university, with English-taught programmes including the PEARL economics degree and GIGA in environment and information studies.

name: University of Helsinki
overview: Finland's oldest and largest research university, offering around thirty English-taught master's programmes with scholarships decided at admission.

name: Aalto University
overview: Formed by merging Finland's technology, business and art universities, Aalto teaches English-medium bachelor's and master's degrees across technology, business and design.

name: University of Turku
overview: A multidisciplinary research university on Finland's south-west coast, with English-taught master's degrees in technology, biosciences, education and economics.

name: Tampere University
overview: Created by merging the University of Tampere and Tampere University of Technology, combining engineering, health sciences and social sciences on one campus.

name: University of Oulu
overview: A northern research university with a strong wireless-communications and information-technology tradition, plus medicine and education.

name: University of Jyvaskyla
overview: A research university best known for education and teacher training, sport and health sciences, and information technology.

name: LUT University
overview: A technology and business university focused on energy systems, sustainability and clean technology, with English-taught degrees at both levels.

name: University of Eastern Finland
overview: A multi-campus university in Joensuu and Kuopio with English-taught master's programmes in forestry, environmental science, health and social sciences.
